CustomField.description: BR-15, BR-16, PD-12. The seller-decision commitment issued when the Lead validly entered MQL: the moment by which Sales must have accepted or explicitly rejected the handoff. A NORTHSTARIQ SYNTHETIC BUSINESS POLICY, not Salesforce behaviour and not a universal RevOps rule. PERSISTED, NOT DERIVED, for the same reason SLA_Target_DateTime__c is: the commitment is pinned as it was issued, so a later policy change cannot retroactively move a deadline that was already given. Lifecycle_Stage_Entered__c cannot substitute - it is overwritten on the next transition and stops answering when MQL was entered. LeadHistory records the transition but no formula field can read it, and history is retention-limited. TIME BASIS: the same documented weekend-aware approximation used for the response SLA - NOT Salesforce Business Hours, and it does NOT honour Holiday records. Written only by Lead_Inbound_Before_Save at the moment MQL is granted.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When a Sales decision on this MQL is due. Set by automation - do not edit.
CustomField.label: Acceptance Due
